A host saved as 'EvilTrout.com' would never match 'eviltrout.com', breaking host authorization. Mechanism is visible in the diff; only uncertainty is whether URI always downcases, so moderate confidence.

adjudication.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb, `record_for_host` sets `host = uri.host` (not downcased) and then queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`. Because only the DB column is lowercased and the bind param is not, a mixed-case referer like `HTTP://Example.COM` yields `uri.host == "Example.COM"`, producing `lower(host) = 'Example.COM'` which will not match a stored `example.com`. Additionally, the `before_validation` normalization strips scheme/path but does not downcase `self.host`, so stored values may also be mixed-case, compounding the mismatch.
